content:
You should use getStaticPaths if you’re statically prerendering pages that use dynamic routes and:

The data comes from a headless CMSThe data comes from a databaseThe data comes from the filesystemThe data can be publicly cached (not user-specific)The page must be prerendered (for SEO) and be very fast — getStaticProps generates HTML and JSON files, both of which can be cached by a CDN for performance
